atoms.text: While on the run from the Vikings, Alfred took refuge in the home of a peasant woman.
The peasant woman did not recognise that Alfred was the King and assumed that he was just another soldier.
The woman was baking “cakes” (small loaves of bread) on her fire. She asked Alfred to watch over them to make sure that they didn’t burn while she went out.
atoms.sound: The woman was baking “cakes” — small loaves of bread — on her fire. She asked Alfred to watch over them to make sure that they didn’t burn while she went out.

atoms.text: Alfred, distracted by his problems, forgot all about this. The woman returned to find her burnt cakes and told the King off!
